props.headline: Contact Us
props.subhead: Ready to get on the road? Contact us to explore our trucks and trailers and experience nothing less than the dedicated care you deserve.

image.alt: The Sun State team — photograph to be supplied

props.text:
A good business starts with the right equipment. Our purpose at Sun State is to help you find the right trucks and trailers for your business, then keep them working.

Ready to place an order? Talk to a member of our sales team about our available inventory, financing, or to schedule an in-person appointment. Need parts or a repair? Use the department numbers below, or send a message and we'll route it to the right team.
Pick the department and location, and we'll get your message to the right person. Fields marked with an asterisk are required.

items.q: What is the main phone number for Sun State?
items.a: Call 800-741-7566 and we'll route you to the right department, or email e-contact@sunstateintl.com. Direct numbers for sales, parts, service, aftermarket and trailer sales are listed on this page.

items.q: Who do I call if my truck is down after hours?
items.a: Certified Fleet provides after-hours service from 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM at (863) 880-2206. Mobile service runs from Tampa, Sarasota and Davenport Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM.

items.q: How do I schedule a service appointment?
items.a: Submit the online service appointment request, or call the service department at your location: Tampa (813) 521-8053, Sarasota (941) 541-3251, Davenport (863) 238-2939.
Talk to Lynn DeJesus at (800) 741-7566 or (813) 621-1331 ext. 1008, or email a completed credit application to Lynn.DeJesus@sunstateintl.com.
Call the parts counter at your nearest location, or order through the online parts store at sunstateparts.com for in-store pickup or delivery.

items.q: How quickly will you respond to a message?
items.a: Messages submitted during business hours are typically answered the same business day. Messages sent overnight or on weekends are handled the next business morning.
